classes.name: Swordsman
classes.summary: Swordsman is the go-to "tank" of the six first jobs. With high HP, access to great defensive gear, and skill options to boost sustain and reduce damage taken, they are adept at getting into bigger fights than they can handle and finding a way to come out on the other side.

skills.name: Sword Mastery
skills.text: Increases damage of 1H/2H Swords

skills.name: Slash
skills.text: Inflicts Bleed

skills.name: Lash Out
skills.text: AoE, heals self on hit

skills.name: Improved Constitution
skills.text: Increases natural HP regen

skills.name: Provoke
skills.text: Inflicts Vulnerable

classes.name: Knight
classes.summary: Knight is the primary advancement option for the Swordsman class. Like Swordsmen before them, Knights rely on naturally high HP, high defensive stats from their available equipment, and increased potion efficiency to sustain themselves in encounters.

skills.name: Two-Handed Sword Mastery
skills.text: Increases damage and Hit with 2H swords.

skills.name: Rend
skills.text: Deals damage and applies Bleed or Vulnerable

skills.name: Devastating Blow
skills.text: AoE Damage and refreshes Bleeding duration.

skills.name: Quicken
skills.text: Dramatically increases offensive stats for a shot duration.

skills.name: Spear Mastery
skills.text: Increases damage and Hit with spears.

classes.name: Lord Knight
classes.summary: Lord Knight is the primary advancement option for Knights. It continues the original path of the knight, tight, rotation based skill patterns, and expands it, adding new skills that can serve as replacements for old skills to enhance the Knight level rotations, or that can slot in happily beside them adding a second full rotation to the menu, filling much of the downtime Knights experienced in their combat with new skills.

skills.name: Vanguard Stance
skills.text: Offensive stance: adds Hit and Agility scaling to all skills.

skills.name: Warden Stance
skills.text: Defensive stance: adds damage reduction and Vitality scaling to all skills.

skills.name: Sonic Wave
skills.text: Ranged shockwave with weapon- and stance-based status effects.

skills.name: Shattering Strike
skills.text: Gap-closing strike with weapon- and stance-based effects.

skills.name: Flourish
skills.text: AoE slash that always inflicts Bleeding.

classes.name: Rune Knight
classes.summary: Rune Knight is the alternative advancement option for Knights. While the Lord Knight continues the orthodox style of the Knight, expanding its stable rotations with more skills that function in much the same way, the Rune Knight takes an entirely different direction.

skills.name: Rune Research
skills.text: Boosts the effectiveness of all Rune Knight skills.

skills.name: Rune Inscription
skills.text: Enables crafting of slottable, single-use Rune Stones.

skills.name: Winter Razor
skills.text: Icy AoE treated as Bleeding Damage.

skills.name: Ignition Break
skills.text: Fiery AoE scaling with Burning Damage bonuses.

skills.name: Burning Breath
skills.text: Ranged fire AoE that inflicts Burning.

classes.name: Crusader
classes.summary: Crusader is the alternative advancement option for the Swordsman class, marrying the inherent defense and damage mitigation strategies of the Swordsman with the holy magic of the Acolyte.

skills.name: Spear Mastery
skills.text: Increases damage and Hit rate of spears.

skills.name: Brilliant Strike
skills.text: Deals damage and applies Blind.

skills.name: Holy Cross
skills.text: Holy elemental double strike that scales with user's DEX.

skills.name: Spear Flurry
skills.text: Dramatically increases ASPD and spear skill cooldowns. Requires a spear.

skills.name: Faith
skills.text: Increases Max HP. Also DEF, and MDEF while wearing a shield.

classes.name: Paladin
classes.summary: Paladin is the primary advancement option for the Crusader. It acts as an extension of the Crusader skill tree, expanding their rotations and replacing some of the lower level skills with higher powered ones.

skills.name: Castigating Aura
skills.text: Holy weapon endow; grants offensive effects to all Paladin skills.

skills.name: Providence
skills.text: Holy armor endow; grants defensive effects to all Paladin skills.

skills.name: Sanctify
skills.text: Consecrated ground that buffs allies and damages enemies.

skills.name: Banishing Strike
skills.text: Holy strike, strongest against Demon, Undead, and Angel races.

skills.name: Overbrand
skills.text: AoE sweep with bonus damage against Bleeding or Blind enemies.

classes.name: Royal Guard
classes.summary: Royal Guard is the alternative advancement option for Crusaders. While Paladins focus on infusing the Crusader's playstyle with additional holy might, the Royal Guard instead opts to turn to sheer physical prowess to protect their allies and dispatch their foes.

skills.name: Radiant Sweep
skills.text: AoE sweep that inflicts Blind.

skills.name: Impale
skills.text: Ranged spear throw that inflicts Bleeding and pins Blind targets.

skills.name: Cannon Spear
skills.text: Line AoE amplified by Bleeding, Blind, and Vulnerable.

skills.name: Shield Press
skills.text: Shield slam that generates a protective Barrier.

skills.name: Shield Shooting
skills.text: Ranged shield throw that generates a protective Barrier.

classes.name: Merchant
classes.summary: The Merchant is the "Bruiser" of the first jobs. Merchants aim to survive their fights in the simplest way possible: kill the enemy fast enough that it can't kill you.

skills.name: Axe Mastery
skills.text: Increases damage of 1H and 2H Axes

skills.name: Axe Boomerang
skills.text: Ranged attack that can Stun

skills.name: Crush
skills.text: Can Crit, can Stun, deals additional damage to Stunned.

skills.name: Extort
skills.text: Deals damage and generates Extort stacks

skills.name: Mammonite
skills.text: Consumes Extort stacks to deal massive damage

classes.name: Blacksmith
classes.summary: Blacksmith is the primary advancement option for the Merchant. In keeping with the Merchant's strategy of "damage over all else," the Blacksmith class has virtually nothing in the way of defensive options, relying on good equipment and exceptional damage output to see it through most encounters.

skills.name: Steel Heart
skills.text: Increases own Neutral resistance and potion effectiveness.

skills.name: Adrenaline Rush
skills.text: Increases own ASPD and Hit rate for a long duration.

skills.name: Weapon Perfection
skills.text: Increases own critical damage for a long duration.

skills.name: Power Thrust
skills.text: Increases own ATK and DEF Pierce for a long duration.

skills.name: Rush Down
skills.text: Charges a distant enemy and generates an Extort stack.

classes.name: Mastersmith
classes.summary: Mastersmith is the primary advancement option for the Blacksmith. It very much continues in the same vein as the Blacksmith before it: build lots of damage and hope the enemy dies before you do, relying almost entirely on gear to build up the survivability needed to make your way through each encounter while your skills deal the maximum damage possible, making those encounters as short as possible.

skills.name: Meltdown
skills.text: Boosts Burning damage; active window converts attacks to half Burning Damage.

skills.name: Whirling Axe
skills.text: Autoattacks gain a chance to splash in a 5x5 area.

skills.name: Berserk
skills.text: Massive ASPD and damage reduction

skills.name: Overwhelm
skills.text: Short-cooldown slam that generates Extort.

skills.name: Cleave
skills.text: Strips defensive statuses and inflicts Vulnerable.

classes.name: Mechanic
classes.summary: Mechanic is the alternative advancement option for Blacksmiths. While the Mastersmith focuses their efforts on drawing the maximum possible power out of the equipment they and their friends use, the Mechanic turns to creating brand new tools to aid them in combat.

skills.name: Madogear Construction
skills.text: Boosts Madogear skills and waives their Extort costs while suited.

skills.name: Machine Slam
skills.text: Massive AoE crush.

skills.name: Arm Cannon
skills.text: Ranged cannon blast, strongest against Stunned targets.

skills.name: Active Shielding
skills.text: Extort-fueled defensive Barrier.

skills.name: Overdrive
skills.text: Refreshes and empowers Madogear skills at the cost of self-Burning.

classes.name: Alchemist
classes.summary: Alchemist is the alternative advancement option for the Merchant. Unlike its first class, the Alchemist enjoys multiple possible playstyles, from the very familiar "all gas no breaks" style of the Merchant to more defensive and supportive options.

skills.name: Chemical Research
skills.text: Improves damage and status effect application of all Chemical skills.

skills.name: Acid Terror
skills.text: Deals damage and can apply Vulnerable. Generates Extort.

skills.name: Demonstration
skills.text: Fire AoE bomb that can cause Burning. Generates Extort.

skills.name: Conflagration
skills.text: Consumes Extort stacks for big AoE Neutral damage. Can cause Burning and Bleeding.

skills.name: Enhancement Research
skills.text: Improves duration and effect of all Alchemical Enhancements.

classes.name: Biochemist
classes.summary: Biochemist is the primary advancement option for Alchemists. They turn their insatiable curiosity for the workings of chemical matter toward the interaction of chemicals with each other and organic bodies.

skills.name: Greater Aid Potion
skills.text: AoE version of Aid Potion using the same Throwable Potions.

skills.name: Incinerate
skills.text: Fire DoT field treated as Burning damage; Extort reduces its cooldown.

skills.name: Acid Cloud
skills.text: Acid burst scaling with Vulnerable Potency; Extort reduces its cooldown.

skills.name: Alchemic Cannon
skills.text: Explosive AoE with bonus damage against Vulnerable and Burning enemies.

skills.name: Acid Demonstration
skills.text: Consumes Extort for an absurd single-target burst.

classes.name: Geneticist
classes.summary: The Geneticist is the alternate advancement option for Alchemists. They turn away from research into chemicals and potions and instead focus on the study of life itself.

skills.name: Fauna Specialization
skills.text: Boosts Homunculi stats and all Fauna skills.

skills.name: Gift of Life
skills.text: Sacrifices HP to heal allies. Eira-themed.

skills.name: Gift of Light
skills.text: Cleanses and shields against statuses. Bayeri-themed.

skills.name: Gift of Venom
skills.text: Poison pool that inflicts Slow. Sera-themed.

skills.name: Gift of Flame
skills.text: Fire burst that inflicts Burning. Dieter-themed.

classes.name: Thief
classes.summary: The Thief occupies a role somewhere between the Swordsman and the Merchant. With more than half of its skill tree dedicated to defensive options, Thieves are remarkably resilient even with their lower HP pools.

skills.name: Dagger Mastery
skills.text: Increases damage, Double Attack rate of Daggers

skills.name: Envenom
skills.text: Poison element damage and inflicts Poison

skills.name: Sand Attack
skills.text: Damage and inflicts Blind

skills.name: Nimbleness
skills.text: Increases Flee and Movement Speed

skills.name: Hiding
skills.text: Avoids most physical and magical attacks for a short duration

classes.name: Assassin
classes.summary: The Assassin is the primary advancement option for the Thief class. While the Thief's skill tree was very much defensively minded, the Assassin uses that foundation to fill their skill bar with offensive options.

skills.name: Toxic Blades
skills.text: Improves damage of Poison applied by the user, adds AGI scaling to Assassin skills.

skills.name: Flashing Blades
skills.text: Improves critical rate, adds DEX scaling to Assassin skills.

skills.name: Rejuvenating Blades
skills.text: Causes all attacks to heal the user, adds VIT scaling to Assassin skills.

skills.name: Katar Mastery
skills.text: Improves damage and Hit rate of Katars.

skills.name: Grimtooth
skills.text: Long range splash attack that applies statuses based on current Blade Enchant.

classes.name: Assassin Cross
classes.summary: Assassin Cross is the primary advancement option for Assassins. In contrast to the Guillotine Cross, which devotes its entire arsenal to the perfection and use of a variety of poisons, the Assassin Cross seeks to perfect their own martial skill.

skills.name: Peerless Blades
skills.text: HP-threshold Blade Enchant that adds Luck scaling to Assassin skills.

skills.name: Deadly Shadow
skills.text: Grants invisibility and empowers the next attack.

skills.name: Soul Destroyer
skills.text: Consumes the active Blade Enchant for a deadly enchant-flavored projectile.

skills.name: Weapon Blocking
skills.text: Blocks a Physical attack and grants the Counter State.

skills.name: Rupture
skills.text: Precision strike that inflicts Vulnerable.

classes.name: Guillotine Cross
classes.summary: Guillotine Cross is the alternative advancement option for Assassins. While Assassin Crosses eschew dependency on Poison for their damage, preferring to rely entirely on combat skill, the Guillotine Cross has no such inhibitions.

skills.name: Fatal Blades
skills.text: Poison-coating Blade Enchant that reshapes the user's Poison.

skills.name: Venom Eater
skills.text: Consumes the target's Poison to heal the user.

skills.name: Toxic Shadow
skills.text: Self-poisoning buff that empowers all Toxin skills.

skills.name: Toxic Breath
skills.text: Poison AoE breath.

skills.name: Toxic Surge
skills.text: Amplifies a target's existing Poison.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.summary: Rogue is the secondary advancement option for the Thief. While the Assassin turns its efforts towards putting out raw damage supplemented by the Status Effects offered by their Thief roots, the Rogue focuses primarily on putting those Status Effects , and as many others as possible , to good use.

skills.name: Predatory Instinct
skills.text: Enhances user's DEX as well as potency of Blind and Vulnerable.

skills.name: Disorient
skills.text: Swift melee attack that applies Vulnerable and immediately Cloaks the rogue.

skills.name: Back Stab
skills.text: Jumps behind target and deals additional damage if target is Vulnerable and/or Blind.

skills.name: Ambush
skills.text: Attacks from Hiding to deal damage to a wide area and apply Vulnerable, Blind.

skills.name: Malicious Instinct
skills.text: Enhances user's LUK as well as potency of Bleed, Burning, and Poison

classes.name: Stalker
classes.summary: Stalker is the primary advancement option for Rogues. Stalkers perfect the quick and dirty fighting style of the Rogue, either capitalizing on Blind and Vulnerable to cripple their opponent's offenses and defenses, or dealing out a large number of damage statuses in quick succession to keep their foes reeling.

skills.name: Stalker's Instinct
skills.text: Halves all skill cooldowns; ends early if the user takes skill damage.

skills.name: Lightning Reflexes
skills.text: Blocks a Physical skill with level-based rewards.

skills.name: Deft Stab
skills.text: Cycles Blind, Vulnerable, and Bleeding.

skills.name: Blindside
skills.text: Gap-closing surprise attack that inflicts Blind.

skills.name: Breakout
skills.text: AoE from Hiding that briefly enables free Ambush casts.

classes.name: Shadow Chaser
classes.summary: The Shadow Chaser is the alternative advancement option for Rogues.

skills.name: Needle Burst
skills.text: Bleeding strike that also Bleeds the user.

skills.name: Scalding Blade
skills.text: Burning strike that also Burns the user.

skills.name: Plague Touch
skills.text: Poison strike that also Poisons the user.

skills.name: Malicious Reprisal
skills.text: Consumes the user's own statuses to amplify and spread them.

skills.name: Bloodletter's Mark
skills.text: Inflicts or detonates Bleeding over an area.

classes.name: Mage
classes.summary: Mage occupies a similar role to the Archer, but shoulders more risk while gunning for a higher reward. The Mage has access to a suite of high damage Bolts of varying elements, allowing them to capitalize on enemy weaknesses where other classes are forced to deal Neutral damage, coupled with a host of AoE skills that can inflict various status effects to multiple enemies simultaneously.

skills.name: Magical Attunement
skills.text: Increases SP regen and lowers SP costs.

skills.name: Fire Bolt
skills.text: Deals Fire damage with bonus damage against Burning targets.

skills.name: Fire Ball
skills.text: Enemy-targeted AoE Fire damage with a chance to inflict Burning.

skills.name: Cold Bolt
skills.text: Deals Water damage with bonus damage against Chilled targets.

skills.name: Frost Blast
skills.text: Enemy-targeted AoE Water damage with a chance to inflict Chill.

classes.name: Wizard
classes.summary: Wizard is the primary advancement option for the Mage.

skills.name: Cloak of Flame
skills.text: Deals constant Fire damage over time in an area around the caster, applying Fire Vulnerability.

skills.name: Crimson Rock
skills.text: Deals massive Fire area damage, inflicting Burning.

skills.name: Freezing Breath
skills.text: Blasts the target area with Water damage, inflicting Chill and Water Vulnerability.

skills.name: Storm Gust
skills.text: Conjures a blizzard in target area, dealing Water damage and inflicting Chill.

skills.name: Jupitel Thunder
skills.text: Fires a ball of Wind energy at a target, applying Wind Vulnerability.

classes.name: High Wizard
classes.summary: High Wizard is the primary advancement option for Wizards. It continues to excel at what the Wizard does best - dish out huge amounts of elemental damage over a wide area.

skills.name: Affinities
skills.text: Affinities come in the four natural elements, Fire, Water, Wind, or Earth.

skills.name: Crimson Arrow
skills.text: Line-piercing Fire bolt with Burning synergy.

skills.name: Volcanic Burst
skills.text: Massive Fire AoE that grants Fire Affinity.

skills.name: Frozen Grip
skills.text: Ice spikes with Chilled synergy.

skills.name: Frost Nova
skills.text: Massive self-centered Water AoE that grants Water Affinity.

classes.name: Warlock
classes.summary: Warlock is the alternative advancement option for Wizards. While their previous job provided them mastery over all of the natural elements, the Warlock is not satisfied with this, and so turns its efforts toward much darker magics.

skills.name: Void Infusion
skills.text: Converts all magic to Ghost, Undead, or Dark property, at a price.

skills.name: Void Channeling
skills.text: Converts Max HP into Void Spheres.

skills.name: Phantasmal Burst
skills.text: Ghost bolt that inflicts Breach and can generate Void Spheres.

skills.name: Phantasmal Crush
skills.text: Ghost AoE amplified by held Void Spheres.

skills.name: Phantasmal Burden
skills.text: Sphere-consuming Ghost DoT scaled by Breach Potency.

classes.name: Sage
classes.summary: Sage is the secondary advancement option for Mages. While the Wizard focuses mainly on turning the control options of Mage into large amounts of damage, the Sage doubles down on the control aspect of their first job, using their new skills to further restrict their enemies' movements, all while dealing consistent damage over a wide area.

skills.name: Elemental Mastery
skills.text: Improves damage caused by and resistance to Fire, Water, Wind, and Earth damage.

skills.name: Fire Wall
skills.text: Creates a wall of intense flame that prevents movement through it and inflicts Burn on contact.

skills.name: Inferno
skills.text: Summons a raging inferno that does Fire damage over time to an area.

skills.name: Chilling Frost
skills.text: Flash-freezes an area, Chilling or Freezing already chilled enemies.

skills.name: Deluge
skills.text: Summons a persistent torrent of water, that does Water damage over time to an area.

classes.name: Scholar
classes.summary: Scholar is the primary advancement option for the Sage. Similar to the Warlock, Scholars are those who have contented themselves with their mastery over the natural elements and so have turned their attention to other forces.

skills.name: Free Cast
skills.text: Move and attack while casting, at reduced speed.

skills.name: Soul Siphon
skills.text: Siphons SP from an enemy and inflicts Breach.

skills.name: Time Shift
skills.text: Instantly reduces the whole party's active cooldowns.

skills.name: Indulge
skills.text: Converts Max HP into instant SP.

skills.name: Soul Infusion
skills.text: Makes an ally's next several skill casts free.

classes.name: Sorcerer
classes.summary: Sorcerer is the alternative advancement option for Sages. While the Scholar focuses its efforts on learning about and leveraging the unique attributes of magic itself, the Sorcerer turns their focus toward the four elemental attributes, manipulating them with control and precision that even the most powerful Wizards would be jealous of.

skills.name: Summon Ardor
skills.text: Summons the fire spirit: Fire MDef Pierce, reduced Water Resistance.

skills.name: Agni's Wrath
skills.text: Fire AoE that triggers the spirit's Attack Skill.

skills.name: Agni's Heat
skills.text: Burning-damage field that triggers the spirit's Support Skill.

skills.name: Summon Diluvio
skills.text: Summons the water spirit: Water MDef Pierce, reduced Wind Resistance.

skills.name: Aqua's Breath
skills.text: Water AoE that triggers the spirit's Attack Skill.

classes.name: Archer
classes.summary: The Archer fills both a damage and offensive support role. With extended range from their bows, they are able to engage enemies from a safe distance and put out steady damage without needing to worry about taking much damage themselves.

skills.name: Bow Mastery
skills.text: Increases range and Hit of Bows.

skills.name: Double Strafe
skills.text: Fires twice, has bonus Crit rate against Slowed targets.

skills.name: Arrow Shower
skills.text: Ground target AoE that knocks back.

skills.name: Pin Down
skills.text: Low damage, Inflicts Slow.

skills.name: Arrow Repel
skills.text: Low damage and strong knockback.

classes.name: Hunter
classes.summary: Hunter is the primary advancement option for the Archer class. It fills much the same role, attempting to finish off enemies from range, but now has a few more tools to aid in the process.

skills.name: Marksman's Focus
skills.text: Greatly increases Hit and Crit Rate.

skills.name: Precision Shot
skills.text: Ranged attack with bonus damage against Slowed targets.

skills.name: Threefold Arrow
skills.text: Three-stage attack applying Slow, Vulnerable, or Stun.

skills.name: Trapper's Focus
skills.text: Removes Trap Fixed Cast Times and extends their status durations.

skills.name: Toxic Mine
skills.text: Trap dealing Poison damage that inflicts Poison.

classes.name: Sniper
classes.summary: Sniper is the primary advancement option for Hunters. It gives up on the usage of both traps and Falcon skills to perfect the use of the bow, becoming something of a Physical Caster designed to bring down enemies from a safe distance.

skills.name: Sniper's Resolve
skills.text: Massive damage reduction per Preparation Counter.

skills.name: Tactical Retreat
skills.text: Repositions without sacrificing Preparation Counters.

skills.name: Called Shot
skills.text: Marks one enemy for maximum damage dealt and minimum taken.

skills.name: Shrouding Shot
skills.text: Generates Preparation; inflicts Blind.

skills.name: Hammer Shot
skills.text: Generates Preparation; knocks the target back.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.summary: Ranger is the alternative advancement option for Hunters. While it provides some support for Marksman and Falcon builds from the Hunter, it focuses most of its efforts on the trapping style of combat, preferring to best their enemies through careful planning and preparation, creating a battlefield that gives them every advantage possible.

skills.name: Hawk Rush
skills.text: Falcon strike that auto-triggers on bow attacks.

skills.name: Punishing Bolt
skills.text: Consumes the target's damaging statuses for a huge single hit.

skills.name: Gale Storm
skills.text: Wide AoE arrow rain that inflicts Slow.

skills.name: Advanced Trap Mastery
skills.text: Extends trap duration and placement range.

skills.name: Wind Trap
skills.text: DoT trap that inflicts Slow, scaling with Slow Potency.

classes.name: Bard and Dancer
classes.summary: Bard and Dancer are the secondary advancement options for Archers. Setting aside their bows, the two performer classes opt for a much more challenging playstyle: it's not good enough to just deal damage, the damage has to be dealt with style!

skills.name: Musical Mastery
skills.text: Increases damage and Hit with Instruments; extends Rhythm duration.

skills.name: Restorative Refrain
skills.text: Party AoE heal over time. Odd Rhythm.

skills.name: Quickening Chorus
skills.text: Reduces party Variable Cast Time. Even Rhythm.

skills.name: Darkening Dirge
skills.text: Inflicts Blind on approaching enemies. Odd Rhythm.

skills.name: Enervating Elegy
skills.text: Inflicts Vulnerable and Breach on approaching enemies. Even Rhythm.

classes.name: Clown/Gypsy
classes.summary: Clown and Gypsy are the primary advancement option for Bards and Dancers. Unlike most third jobs, where the primary advancement option sticks close in theme and function to the original job, Clown and Gypsy both diverge quite significantly from the playstyle of Bard and Dancer.

skills.name: Voluminous Volley
skills.text: Multi-hit volley scaling with Rhythm.

skills.name: Ravaging Rainstorm
skills.text: Consumes Rhythm to accelerate an arrow storm.

skills.name: Rhythmic Retort
skills.text: Magic pulse that tunes the user's Rhythm toward three.

skills.name: Crushing Concerto
skills.text: Consumes Rhythm for a multi-hit sound wave.

skills.name: Tarot Card: The Magician
skills.text: Adds flat MATK% to an ally's magic skills.

classes.name: Minstrel/Wanderer
classes.summary: Minstrel and Wanderer are the alternative advancement options for Bard and Dancer. They pick up the support mantle that the Clown and Gypsy abandoned, enhancing the already impressive support abilities of the Bard and Dancer with their own unique twist.

skills.name: Improvised Interlude
skills.text: Instantly sets the user's Rhythm level.

skills.name: Desperate Dynamic
skills.text: Mass-applies Melodic Mark to enemies and Hypnotic Harmony to allies.

skills.name: Melodic Mark
skills.text: Curses a target to be struck by the user's note skills.

skills.name: Sonorant Spike
skills.text: Detonates all Marks for Physical damage and Internal Bleeding.

skills.name: Ruinous Rhapsody
skills.text: Detonates all Marks for Magic damage and Burning.

classes.name: Acolyte
classes.summary: Though the Acolyte finds its roots in the support classes of old, don't let that fool you. Acolytes are more than capable of braving the wilds on their own, with access to a number of damaging skills beyond just offensive Heal.

skills.name: Heal
skills.text: Restores target's HP, deals damage to Undead enemies.

skills.name: Blessing
skills.text: Increases target's Hit, Flee, and Perfect Dodge.

skills.name: Piety
skills.text: Improves max SP, SP Regen, and Healing Power.

skills.name: Mace Mastery
skills.text: Increases damage and hit rate of Maces.

skills.name: Holy Light
skills.text: Magical attack that deals more damage under Aspersio.

classes.name: Priest
classes.summary: Priest is the primary advancement option for the Acolyte. Much like the Acolyte, Priests have a solid mixture of supportive abilities meant to keep themselves and their party alive, as well as powerful offensive abilities specialized for exorcizing the undead and unnatural.

skills.name: Divine Grace
skills.text: Empowers Grace skills; links Grace casts to Authority skill levels.

skills.name: Aspersio
skills.text: Endows party weapons with the Holy property.

skills.name: Renovatio
skills.text: Party AoE heal over time.

skills.name: Impositio Manus
skills.text: Cleanses damaging statuses from the party and grants brief immunity.

skills.name: Offertorium
skills.text: Boosts Healing Power and autocasts Smite on attacks.

classes.name: High Priest
classes.summary: High Priest is the primary advancement option for Priests. High Priest very much follows in the same footsteps as the Priest, dividing their skills cleanly between Grace and Authority, and allowing skills of either side to enhance the skill levels of the other if used in the correct order.

skills.name: Lux Divina
skills.text: Grants or raises the Authority status, up to level 15.

skills.name: Lux Aeterna
skills.text: Grants or raises the Grace status, up to level 15.

skills.name: Coluceo Heal
skills.text: Instantly heals the entire party for a Heal-equivalent amount.

skills.name: Gloria
skills.text: Raises the party's Crit Rate and ASPD Limit.

skills.name: Magnificat
skills.text: Reduces party SP costs and prevents cast interruption.

classes.name: Arch Bishop
classes.summary: Arch Bishop is the alternative advancement option for Priests. While the Priest divided its skills between supportive Grace Skills and offensive Authority skills, the Arch Bishop instead divides its skills into three general branches, each of which offering a Grace Skill, an Authority Skill, and an unaligned skill to tie them together.

skills.name: Oratio
skills.text: Curses enemies to take burst damage whenever struck by Holy attacks.

skills.name: Arbitrium
skills.text: Single-target Holy nuke with Magic Pierce and Searing Light.

skills.name: Adoramus
skills.text: Wide Holy AoE; consumes Grace or Authority for debuffs.

skills.name: Grace Heal
skills.text: Large single-target heal that leaves a protective barrier.

skills.name: Argutus Vita
skills.text: Party-wide Attack and Magic Attack buff.

classes.name: Monk
classes.summary: Monk is the secondary advancement option for the Acolyte class. It forgoes the majority of its ancestor's supportive potential to focus on closing out fights in the best way possible: damage, damage, and more damage.

skills.name: Spiritual Discipline
skills.text: Increases the damage of all Spirit skills.

skills.name: Soul Piercer
skills.text: Armor-piercing strike that gains damage from the target's Defense.

skills.name: Spiritual Lash
skills.text: Long-range spiritual projectile.

skills.name: Soul Quake
skills.text: Finisher: AoE blast that consumes Discipline and Iron Fists.

skills.name: Fist Mastery
skills.text: Boosts Fist damage, ASPD, and Hit; grants the Iron Fists status.

classes.name: Champion
classes.summary: Champion is the primary advancement option for the Monk. While Monks found themselves with the option to dedicate themselves to either Spiritual or Combo skills, the Champion seeks to marry these two skill branches together into a perfect harmony.

skills.name: Zen
skills.text: Grants both Iron Fists and Discipline at double level.

skills.name: Unburden
skills.text: Consumes the stances to restore HP or SP.

skills.name: Raging Barrage
skills.text: Single-target barrage of blows.

skills.name: Raging Windmill
skills.text: Point-blank AoE combo strike.

skills.name: Falling Mountain
skills.text: Combo finisher: one crushing blow that consumes the stances.

classes.name: Sura
classes.summary: Sura is the alternative advancement option for the Monk. While Champion sought to bring the Combo and Spirit sides of the Monk tree into harmony, the Sura doubles down on specialization, preferring to focus entirely on one side and drawing out its maximum potential.

skills.name: Burning Faith
skills.text: Stigmata damage passive; active empowers the Monk Combo skills.

skills.name: Judge's Conviction
skills.text: Applies Stigmata stacks to all nearby enemies.

skills.name: Furious Thrust
skills.text: Quick jab that applies Stigmata.

skills.name: Furious Barrage
skills.text: Rapid strikes; Iron Fists refreshes Furious Thrust.

skills.name: Furious Execution
skills.text: Combo finisher applying 3 Stigmata stacks.

classes.name: Taekwon
classes.summary: The Taekwon is the first of the Expanded Classes, a group of classes outside the core six starter classes that sport somewhat more complicated class mechanics than usual, and may have somewhat abnormal class structures.

skills.name: Martial Training
skills.text: Increases STR, Hit, Unarmed Damage

skills.name: Martial Endurance
skills.text: Increases VIT, healing potion recovery

skills.name: Martial Discipline
skills.text: Increases INT, SP potion recovery

skills.name: Martial Precision
skills.text: Increases DEX, DEF pierce

skills.name: Martial Agility
skills.text: Increases AGI, flee

classes.name: Star Gladiator
classes.summary: The Star Gladiator is the first advancement option for the Taekwon. Though it still utilizes some of the core Taekwon skills, it begins the journey of moving away from simple martial arts and into wielding cosmic powers beyond that any other job can hope to harness.

skills.name: Cosmic Insight
skills.text: Increases damage and Hit with Books; passively raises Luk.

skills.name: Solar Heat
skills.text: Boosts Burning damage dealt and Burn/Chill resistance.

skills.name: Solar Pulse
skills.text: Blazing kick with a high chance to inflict Burning.

skills.name: Lunar Protection
skills.text: Reduces status damage taken and resists Bleeding/Vulnerable.

skills.name: Lunar Glow
skills.text: Heavy blow that cleanses statuses and restores HP under Lunar Protection.

classes.name: Star Emperor
classes.summary: Star Emperor is the primary advancement option for Star Gladiators. The Star Emperor fully embraces the cosmic powers of the Star Gladiator, all but abandoning their roots in Taekwon Do to draw themselves closer to the cosmos.

skills.name: Solar Flash
skills.text: Focused strike that detonates Burning for five ticks at once.

skills.name: Solar Prominence
skills.text: Self-centered blast with a chance to inflict Burning.

skills.name: Lunar Eclipse
skills.text: Lifestealing strike that grants Cloaking.

skills.name: Lunar Advent
skills.text: Devastating lifestealing strike; double damage from Cloaking.

skills.name: Stellar Flicker
skills.text: Quick strike that Marks the target, reducing their Defense.

classes.name: Sky Emperor
classes.summary: Sky Emperor is the alternative advancement option for Star Gladiators. While the Star Emperor expands their abilities by drawing closer to the cosmos, the Sky Emperor focuses their efforts on how those same celestial bodies interact with the earth, tracking their movements through the sky to draw their power out.

skills.name: Sunrise
skills.text: Splashing sun strike; inflicts Burning or Internal Bleeding by state.

skills.name: Brilliant Noon
skills.text: Single-target strike that enhances the target's damaging statuses.

skills.name: Duskfall
skills.text: Heavy strike that refreshes the Daylight skills and advances the Celestial State.

skills.name: Moonrise
skills.text: Point-blank moon AoE; inflicts Blind or Vulnerable by state.

skills.name: Dead of Night
skills.text: Whirling AoE kick that refreshes status durations.

classes.name: Soul Linker
classes.summary: While the Star Gladiator begins the process of distancing themselves from their roots in Taekwon Do, the Soul Linker wastes no time, abandoning them immediately and without hesitation.

skills.name: Soul Harmony
skills.text: Boosts Hit and cast speed with Souls; unlocks all skills regardless of weapon requirements.

skills.name: Vicious Possession
skills.text: Converts MATK to ATK; Int and Dex grant Crit Rate and Crit Damage.

skills.name: Spectral Thrust
skills.text: Ghost property strike with knockback and a Vulnerable chance.

skills.name: Spectral Claw
skills.text: Ghost property AoE that increases Physical damage taken by enemies struck.

skills.name: Spectral Veil
skills.text: Blocks a single Physical hit; restores HP on a successful block.

classes.name: Soul Reaper
classes.summary: Soul Reaper is the primary advancement option for Soul Linkers. Leveraging their mastery over spirits of the dead, the Soul Reaper turns their studies to mastering the wicked and evil spirits that torment the world, turning their malice into a powerful weapon.

skills.name: Evil Spirit Mastery
skills.text: Explains the Spirit mechanic: generation, the 10-Spirit cap, and the Max HP upkeep cost.

skills.name: Spiteful Spirit
skills.text: Single-target Ghost magic that inflicts Breach; generates 1 Spirit.

skills.name: Tormented Spirit
skills.text: Ghost magic AoE that inflicts Slow; generates 3 Spirits.

skills.name: Doomed Spirit
skills.text: Huge Ghost magic blast; stronger against debuffed enemies; generates 6 Spirits.

skills.name: Spiteful Shade
skills.text: Single-target Ghost strike that inflicts Vulnerable; generates 1 Spirit.

classes.name: Soul Ascetic
classes.summary: Soul Ascetic is the alternative advancement option for Soul Linkers. While Soul Reapers turn their efforts toward studying and mastering the evil spirits that plague the world, Soul Ascetics instead focus on communing with the spirits of the natural world, turning their otherwise aimless, but still very potent, power toward good.

skills.name: Ritual of Invocation
skills.text: Instantly gains AP; buffs Crit Rate and reduces Fixed Cast Times.

skills.name: Ritual of Binding
skills.text: Instantly drains AP; buffs Attack Speed and reduces SP costs.

skills.name: Talisman of Protection
skills.text: Grants an ally a Barrier that strengthens near 100 AP.

skills.name: Talisman of War
skills.text: Boosts an ally's Vulnerable and Breach Potency.

skills.name: Curse of Absorption
skills.text: Ghost magic strike that inflicts Breach.

classes.name: Ninja
classes.summary: The Ninja seeks to fill the role of the proverbial "jack of all trades." Even at the first job level they possess a wide variety of skills, from melee and gap closers, to ranged and spacing, to single target and AoE magic.

skills.name: Dagger Mastery
skills.text: Increases damage, double attack chance, and hit rate of daggers.

skills.name: Flashing Steel
skills.text: Damage that ignores Flee, scales with INT and DEX.

skills.name: Soaring Steel
skills.text: Ranged dash attack, scaled with INT and DEX.

skills.name: Throwing Mastery
skills.text: Increases skill levels of skills gained by equipping subweapons.

skills.name: Departing Shadow
skills.text: Ranged attack that also backslides user, scales with STR and INT.

classes.name: Kagemusha
classes.summary: Kagemusha, once known as Kagerou and Oboro, is the primary advancement option for Ninjas. After spending a hundred levels perfecting their use of physical, ranged, and magical combat styles, the Kagemusha continue along the same path, adding explosive power to each style of ninjutsu.

skills.name: Mikiri
skills.text: Perfectly evades the next skill; a successful read buffs Str and refreshes Crushing Steel.

skills.name: Fulminant Steel
skills.text: Lightning-fast strike; alone under First Art, refreshes the Ninja dagger skills.

skills.name: Ravenous Steel
skills.text: Slashing AoE that can heal per enemy struck.

skills.name: Crushing Steel
skills.text: Massive splash blow that can Stun everything it hits.

skills.name: Shifting Shadow
skills.text: Dex buff that teleports the user back to the cast location when it ends.

classes.name: Maboroshi
classes.summary: Maboroshi, previously known as Shinkiro and Shiranui, is the alternative advancement option for Ninjas. While the Kagemusha focuses on perfecting the use of their original Ninja techniques, learning advanced ways to make use of their original three Ninja Arts, the Maboroshi decides that original Ninja skills weren't complicated enough, and decides to kick things up a notch.

skills.name: Deadly Mirage
skills.text: Dash strike that leaves a Mirage; can grant First Art.

skills.name: Fading Mirage
skills.text: Dash escape into Cloaking that leaves a Mirage.

skills.name: Treacherous Mirage
skills.text: Illusion that makes a skill attack miss, generating Mirages.

skills.name: Stalking Mirage
skills.text: Summons all three Mirages at once.

skills.name: Prowling Steel
skills.text: Shadow-blade AoE that triggers Mirage casts by Art pair.

classes.name: Gunslinger
classes.summary: The Gunslinger occupies a space very similar to that of the mage: a ranged character that specializes in dishing out multiple status effects and taking advantage of them to deal exceptional amounts of damage. As one might guess from the name, however, the manner they choose to do this is a bit different.

skills.name: Firearms Mastery
skills.text: Increases damage and hit rate of all Guns.

skills.name: Rapid Reload
skills.text: Instantly refreshes skill cooldowns usable by equipped weapon

skills.name: Redeploy
skills.text: Instantly moves to target location, refreshes finisher skill of current weapon.

skills.name: Quick Draw
skills.text: Revolver skill. Hits twice and inflicts Slow.

skills.name: Rapid Shower
skills.text: Revolver finisher. Hits several times, increased damage on Vulnerable or Bleeding targets.

classes.name: Rebel
classes.summary: Rebel is the primary advancement option for Gunslingers. As with the Gunslinger before them, the Rebel's kit focuses around rapidly switching between Revolvers, Rifles, and Shotguns to deliver a wide range of status effects, using them to maximize their damage potential.

skills.name: Bullet Time
skills.text: Massive Perfect Dodge buff at the cost of Movement Speed.

skills.name: Gunslinger's Gambit
skills.text: Reduces all cooldowns to 1 second while immobilized.

skills.name: Disengage
skills.text: Backsliding shot; upgrades Slow to Internal Bleeding.

skills.name: Rapid Blitz
skills.text: Teleports behind the target; upgrades Slow to Vulnerable.

skills.name: Penetrating Shot
skills.text: Line pierce; upgrades Vulnerable to Internal Bleeding.

classes.name: Night Watch
classes.summary: Night Watch is the alternative advancement option for Gunslingers. Similar to the Rebel, the Night Watch focuses on expanding the original options of the Gunslinger.

skills.name: Revolver Specialization
skills.text: Revolver stance: Slow Potency and enhanced Revolver skills.

skills.name: Unload
skills.text: Revolver dump that interacts with Crimson Marker; generates a Grenade.

skills.name: Rifle Specialization
skills.text: Rifle stance: Vulnerable Potency and enhanced Rifle skills.

skills.name: Hammer Round
skills.text: Explosive splash round; consumes Crimson Marker for bonus damage.

skills.name: Shotgun Specialization
skills.text: Shotgun stance: Bleeding Damage and enhanced Shotgun skills.
